components.gap: Barwise's Cut-Elimination Theorem 4.14 (Gentzen): any sequent that has a derivation with the cut rule has one without it, i.e. G+ and G have the same derivable sequents. It is stated at w02-p02-005 lines 1066-1072 but recorded only as Barwise's claim (line 1075: 'Neither route is carried out for G'). The source gives its proof route on printed p. 40: prove completeness of the cut-free system G directly, expanding the proof of the propositional part 4.12 to G's equality axioms, equality rule and four quantifier rules. Owed: that complete route written out with its exact hypotheses (G's sequents, the eigenvariable condition on (|-forall) and (exists|-), the equality axioms and rule), i.e. a written proof that every sequent true in all structures is derivable in G, from which 4.14 follows with complete steps. Separately, the owned-file results that make Barwise's recursion 'by induction on length' define a function and that justify his truth-table test are written with complete annex proofs but are route pending.
components.note: Every other numbered source result (2.1-2.8, 3.x, 4.1-4.13, 5.1-5.6) has a host with a written annex proof; compactness and Lowenheim-Skolem are proved by Barwise's Main-Lemma route as well. 5.7 (Lindstrom; handbook thm:lindstrom at inherited-12415-12536.tex:104-112 is 'cited theorem'), Keisler's completeness/compactness for L(Q) and the Section 2 decidability/incompleteness claims are stated as attributed claims; the source gives no proof of them either.

Source examples and counterexamples (group, ring, field and set axioms; Z_p; the torsion construction; *R; the PIR exercise; term and formula examples; the two- and three-letter truth tables with the backward method; map colouring; the five first-order tautology/non-tautology sentences; the converse of 4.3; the G derivation; the closing exercise; Euclidean rings) are worked on the route with the hypotheses under which each applies. The owned file adds the counterexample showing readability is a hypothesis on P and works the five sentences through the truth-table test (route pending).

Foreword, first-page acknowledgement, every attribution, every referral (Chapters A.2-A.7, C.1, C.3, D.1, D.2; Shoenfield; Smullyan), the seven-entry reference list and the argument-relevant truth tables are preserved; the held scan has no missing figure.
